code:
name: CI
on:
  push:
  pull_request:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: 22
          cache: npm
      - run: npm ci
      - run: npm test
description: Continuous integration workflow that runs npm ci and npm test on push and pull request on ubuntu-latest with Node 22.

steps.description: Triggers: runs on push and pull_request events.
Steps: actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4 with Node 22 and npm cache.
Npm: npm ci to install exact dependencies.
Test: npm test to run the suite.

title: GitHub Actions: CI Workflow
